sources.title: ChorusTIC Enables Training-Free Time Series Classification w ...
sources.snippet: ChorusTIC is a new foundation model for multivariate time series classification that performs in-context classification without requiring task-specific parameter updates. It handles diverse channel configurations by modeling temporal and cross-channel interactions and uses context-derived distributions for predictions.

sources.title: ChorusTIC: Training-Free Multivariate Time Series Classification via ...
sources.snippet: ChorusTIC targets the missing training-free multivariate setting ChorusTIC is a classification-native foundation model evaluated on the complete UEA-30 and UCR-128 archives. It predicts labels for an unlabeled query set from a labeled context set, keeping every model parameter fixed on the target dataset.
